$comment: Topic vocabulary for rows (attributes.topic, attributes.subtopic, attributes.also) and for stance coding. A row has one primary topic (a domain), an optional subtopic for nuance, and optional secondary domains in `also`. Stance (-2..+2) is read against the domain's poles.

topics.label: Export controls
topics.definition: Controls on exporting or importing chips, minerals, technology and data; entity listings and sanctions tied to them.

topics.label: China race
topics.definition: US-China technology competition, self-reliance and how each side frames the other.
topics.neg: China is a threat to contain
topics.pos: China is a peer to engage

topics.label: Chips and compute
topics.definition: Chip supply, domestic chips, compute infrastructure and disclosure of compute used.

topics.label: Regulation
topics.definition: Binding AI, data and platform rules, compliance with them, and foreign regulators' actions.

topics.label: Competition
topics.definition: Antitrust probes, merger review, pricing and responses to rivals.

topics.label: Industrial policy
topics.definition: State plans, programmes, standards and promotion of AI sectors.

topics.label: Products
topics.definition: Model and product releases, launches and their terms.

topics.label: Safety risk
topics.definition: AI safety and security risks, incidents, and how actors frame them.

topics.label: Open source
topics.definition: Open weights, licensing and openness of models and tools.

topics.label: Copyright and IP
topics.definition: Training-data rights, model copying and distillation claims.

topics.label: Energy
topics.definition: Power and data-centre build-out for AI.

topics.label: Bias
topics.definition: Fairness and ideological content in AI systems.

topics.label: Sanctions and trade
topics.definition: Tariffs, trade remedies and retaliation beyond export controls.
